title: Mirror Lab
objectives: List the properties of a plane mirror image
Understand virtual, erect and same-size images

stages.title: The Mirror Room
stages.narration: Reach for shard 4 and you may grab only its image. Learn the mirror's rules, Mirror Mage!

steps.text: Shard 4 shimmers inside a room of plane mirrors.
Umbra scrawls a reversed secret word on the wall.
Arjun: 'It only reads right in a mirror!'

stages.title: True or False: Plane Mirror Image
stages.prompt: Decide whether each statement about a plane mirror image is true or false.

tasks.label: The image is the same size as the object
tasks.explain: A plane mirror image is always the same size.

tasks.label: The image is closer to the mirror than the object
tasks.explain: It is the SAME distance behind the mirror as the object is in front.

tasks.label: The image can be caught on a screen
tasks.explain: It is virtual — it cannot be formed on a screen.

tasks.label: The image is upright (erect)
tasks.explain: A plane mirror gives an erect, upright image.

stages.title: Which Letters Look the SAME in a Mirror?
stages.prompt: Tap the capital letters that look UNCHANGED in a plane mirror.

feedback.correct: Yes! This letter is symmetrical left-to-right, so the mirror doesn't change it.
feedback.incorrect: This letter gets laterally inverted — it looks reversed in a mirror.

stages.title: Mini-Boss: Read Umbra's Secret
stages.prompt: Score 80% to decode the reversed message and seize shard 4!

questions.q: A plane mirror image is best described as…
questions.explain: Plane mirror images are virtual, erect and the same size.

questions.q: You stand 3 m from a mirror. Your image is…
questions.explain: The image is as far behind the mirror as you are in front — 3 m.
A plane mirror flips left and right, not top and bottom.

questions.q: 'AMBULANCE' is written reversed on the vehicle so that…
options: drivers ahead read it correctly in their mirror
questions.explain: The rear-view mirror flips it back to normal for drivers ahead.

questions.q: How far does your image move if you step 1 m toward the mirror?
questions.explain: The image always mirrors your distance, so it steps 1 m closer as well.

stages.title: Crystal Shard 4 Recovered!
messages: 🏅 You earned the Mirror Mage badge
💎 Rainbow Crystal: 4 of 8 shards restored — halfway!
You read Umbra's reversed plan and outsmarted him.
